title: Health and mana orbs
changes: New bottom bar: a red health orb and a blue mana orb, each guarded by a stone gargoyle, with the experience bar, your skills and potions on a bronze plate between them.
Spell keys layout: when a prompt says E (talk, open a chest, use a portal...), E does that instead of casting its spell.
Blizzard's storm is a little lighter on the frame rate.
